title: Another resource is loaded from path (possible cyclic resource inclusion).
body:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bfdbe2ec-fffe-4b50-b2fe-49519a6bfa6b

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/573ee3a6-cb37-405f-acdf-6be6d5efbc78

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5cb40d91-a5dc-4aaa-a55e-331dfbc695d3

### Tested versions

Was able to reproduce on 4.6.1, 4.6, 4.5, and 4.5.beta1.
Not observed in 4.5.dev5 or lower (yet.)
Seems more prevalent on recent versions.

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 63.14 GiB memory

### Issue description

Godot produces:
ERROR: Another resource is loaded from path 'res://main.tscn::h2yge' (possible cyclic resource inclusion).
In a simple scene with one exported Curve resource.

I've tried a couple other resource types such as JSON and was able to replicate the error with little effort.
So it does not seem unique to only the Curve resource. I first observed the error with a custom resource type.

Was able to reproduce on 4.6.1, 4.6, 4.5, and 4.5.beta1.
Not observed in 4.5.dev5 or lower (yet.)
Seems more prevalent on recent versions.

Average save / load attempts required to observe error:
Godot 4.7.dev1 -- 7 save/load attempts
Godot 4.6.1.stable -- 7 save/load attempts
Godot 4.6.stable -- 7 save/load attempts
Godot 4.5.stable -- 14 save/load attempts
Godot 4.5.beta1 -- 14 save/load attempts; also sometimes get error:  ERROR: Task 'generate_thumbnails' already exists.

Godot 4.5.dev5 -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)
Godot 4.5.dev4 -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)
Godot 4.5.dev1 -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)
Godot 4.4.1stable -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)
Godot 4.4.stable -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)
Godot 4.3.stable -- N/A (tried 20+ save/load attempts and did not see any errors.)

### Steps to reproduce

Open the example project in engine of choice (4.6, 4.5, 4.4.)
Repeatedly create and remove the exported resource, saving the scene intermittently.
(I am not sure if the bug will occur without saving the scene.)
So far I've only seen this triggered by manually using the mouse to clear and add resource.
Using Undo/Redo commands has not triggered it for me.

Check console output logs -- sometimes the error is difficult to reproduce.
After anywhere from 5 to 20 tries you should see the error.

Once the error occurs once, it is more likely to repeat until the resource is cleared, the scene is saved, and the project/scene is reloaded.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[cyclic-resource-error.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25451158/cyclic-resource-error.zip)
